name: mix-final-actual
description: Mix a folder of audio tracks on a real mixing console: your coding agent makes the mix from the console's measurements, then you keep tweaking it in a mixer page in your browser and hear every change at once.

interface.shortDescription: Your agent mixes your multitrack; you tweak it live in the browser.
interface.longDescription: Give your agent a folder of audio tracks named by instrument. It mixes them on a real DSP console (EQ, compression, gate, de-esser, reverb, echo, glue compressor, limiter) by reading the console's measurements turn by turn, then a mixer page opens in your browser where you can change anything, hear it at once, and ask the agent for more changes.
defaultPrompt: Mix the tracks in this folder
